meta.name: Linternas
meta.description: El nuevo recluta John Stewart y la leyenda Hal Jordan, dos policías intergalácticos, se ven envueltos en un oscuro misterio terrestre mientras investigan un asesinato en el corazón de Estados Unidos.

videos.title: Piloto
videos.overview: Tras un tiroteo fatal, el Linterna Verde Hal Jordan y el nuevo recluta John Stewart deben demostrar que se trató de un suceso extraterrestre.

videos.title: Salto de Fe
videos.overview: Mientras la misión insignificante de John resulta ser trascendental, Hal causa revuelo en Rushville, lo que lo lleva a indagar más a fondo.

videos.title: Marginado
videos.overview: Tras toda una vida de preparación, John finalmente tiene la oportunidad de entrevistarse con los Guardianes.

videos.title: El Señuelo
videos.overview: Con el plazo de 48 horas a punto de vencer, John desarrolla una nueva teoría sobre el paradero del Cazador, lo que lo lleva, junto con Hal, a presentar su próximo plan a la sheriff Kane. Mientras tanto, la visita de Hal a Sinestro trae consecuencias.

videos.title: Fuera Luces
videos.overview: A medida que se devela la historia de la familia Macon sale a la luz, Rushville se prepara para la amenaza. Mientras John se ve obligado a enfrentar una situación imposible, Hal lo arriesga todo en un último intento por acabar con el Cazador.

videos.title: Mala Imagen
videos.overview: Mientras John intenta seguir adelante, los misterios de Rushville se niegan a dejarlo ir.

videos.title: El Legado de los Jordan
videos.overview: En otro planeta, Hal y John deben dejar de lado su pasado conflictivo para resolver un asesinato. A lo largo de su viaje, ambos se ven obligados a enfrentarse a los fantasmas de su pasado... y a la manera en que su infancia moldeó quiénes son hoy.

videos.title: Polvo y Estrellas
videos.overview: Mientras John continúa su búsqueda del asesino, un nuevo y escalofriante descubrimiento sale a la luz.

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 1, "Pilot"
videos.overview:
Welcome to Lanterns: The Official Podcast. Host Juju Green kicks off the series with an inside look at Lanterns Episode 1, "Pilot," alongside the creative team behind the DC Studios series: Chris Mundy (Showrunner, Executive Producer, Co-Creator, Writer), Damon Lindelof (Executive Producer, Co-Creator, Writer), and Tom King (Executive Producer, Co-Creator, Writer). 

The conversation covers how Lanterns found its identity as a character-driven mystery, why Nebraska became the perfect setting, the creative influences that shaped the series, and how the team approached adapting decades of Green Lantern mythology while making the story welcoming for new viewers. Juju also asks about the casting of Kyle Chandler as Hal Jordan and Aaron Pierre as John Stewart, the show's approach to legacy, and the balance between grounded storytelling and cosmic spectacle.

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 2, "Trust Fall"
videos.overview:
What does it take to bring the Green Lantern mythos down to Earth? In Lanterns: The Official Podcast, Juju Green sits down with showrunner, executive producer, co-creator and writer Chris Mundy, writer and co-executive producer Vanessa Baden Kelly, and director and executive producer James Hawes to break down Episode 2, “Trust Fall.” 

The creators discuss building the grounded world of Lanterns, separating John Stewart and Hal Jordan, designing their approach to flight, and crafting the episode’s massive car chase. They also reveal how Earl, Hal Jordan’s bizarre alien pet, went from a writers’ room idea to one of the episode’s most memorable characters. 

Plus, the team discusses the 48-hour clock, John and Hal’s evolving trust, bringing the iconic villain Sinestro into the story, finding the right balance between comic book mythology and grounded drama, and the process of bringing Sinestro and the Green Lantern elements to life.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E3

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 3, "OutKast"
videos.overview:
In Lanterns: The Official Podcast, Juju Green breaks down Episode 3, “OutKast,” with writer and co-executive producer Vanessa Baden Kelly, director Stephen Williams, and Aaron Pierre, who plays John Stewart. 

Vanessa and Stephen reveal how they built John Stewart's origin story, why the episode is structured across multiple timelines, and how the Guardian interview became a powerful lens for John's identity and experience. They also discuss the Stewart family's approach to raising John, the challenges of making him a formidable Green Lantern, and the performances that brought his family to life. 

Then Aaron Pierre joins Juju to talk about the responsibility of becoming the first live-action John Stewart, his approach to John's physicality and stillness, the character's military background, and the emotional psychology beneath his calm exterior.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E4

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 4, "The Weenie"
videos.overview:
In Lanterns: The Official Podcast, Juju Green breaks down Episode 4, “The Weenie,” with writer and producer Breannah Gibson, actor Garret Dillahunt, and Poorna Jagannathan. 

Breannah Gibson reveals how Sinestro, the Guardians, and the episode's “weenie” theme shape Hal Jordan and John Stewart's increasingly complicated partnership. Garret Dillahunt talks about playing William Macon, his Green Lantern comic book roots, and preparing for one of the episode's most unexpected scenes. Poorna Jagannathan goes inside Zoe's journey, her connection with John, and the emotional impact of the episode's major reveal.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E5

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 5, "Lights Out"
videos.overview: Juju Green breaks down Lanterns Episode 5, “Lights Out,” with writer Justin Britt-Gibson and Kelly Macdonald, who plays Sheriff Kerry Kane. From the fall of Rushville to John Stewart and Hal Jordan's brutal fight, the episode takes Lanterns into some of its biggest emotional territory yet.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E6
videos.overview: Damon Lindeloff, Chris Mundy, and the production team explore the emotional stakes and character development behind a pivotal sequence in Lanterns.  The creators discuss the narrative choices involved in crafting a complex, high-pressured scenes that challenged the protagonists and define their motivation throughout the series.

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 6, "Bad Optics"
videos.overview:
In Episode 6 of Lanterns: The Official Podcast, host Juju Green breaks down “Bad Optics” with co-executive producer and writer Justin Britt-Gibson and director Stephen Williams, before sitting down with Grammy Award-winning composer Stephanie Economou to talk about the music behind the series. 

Juju, Justin, and Stephen get into John Stewart's return to Rushville, the show's 10-year time jump, the evolution of Super Heroes in the DC Universe, Hal Jordan's self-written eulogy, and Nathan Fillion's scene-stealing take on Guy Gardner. 

Then, Stephanie Economou goes inside the creation of the Lanterns score, from John Stewart and Hal Jordan's distinct musical identities to the '90s rock influences, experimental sounds, silence in Hal's funeral, and the score's relationship to the episode's final needle drop.

videos.title: Inside the Episode: S1 E7
videos.overview: Get the inside scoop on the alien planet from Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler.

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 7, "The Jordan Boys’ Legacy"
videos.overview:
In Episode 7 of Lanterns: The Official Podcast, Juju Green sits down with Lanterns showrunner, co-creator, executive producer and writer Chris Mundy and co-creator, executive producer and writer Tom King to break down “The Jordan Boys' Legacy.” Together, they discuss the evolving relationship between John Stewart and Hal Jordan, the meaning of legacy, and the fear that connects both characters. 

Juju, Chris, and Tom also get into Hal Jordan’s complicated relationship with his father, the role of fear and recklessness in Hal’s story, John’s confrontation with his own past, and how the series brings Green Lantern comic lore into a grounded television world. Plus, Tom and Chris reveal how they built the alien planet practically in the California desert, discuss Sinestro’s place in the Green Lantern legacy, and explain how changes from the comics shaped the show.

videos.title: Lanterns: The Official Podcast | Episode 8, "Dirt and Stars"
videos.overview:
It’s the season finale of Lanterns: The Official Podcast. Juju Green sits down with showrunner, writer, co-creator and executive producer Chris Mundy, co-creator, writer and executive producer Damon Lindelof, and co-creator, writer and executive producer Tom King to break down Episode 8, “Dirt and Stars.” 

The conversation goes deep on John Stewart accepting the Green Lantern mantle, Hal Jordan’s legacy, the emotional choices behind the finale, the new Green Lantern oath, Sinestro’s influence, the John Stewart and Noah Macon relationship, and the creative decisions that brought the season to a close.  

Then, Juju talks with Shea Pritchard, who plays Noah Macon, about stepping into the role, working with Aaron Pierre and Kyle Chandler, Noah’s biggest choices in the finale, and the nature-versus-nurture themes at the heart of his character. Plus, Ulrich Thomsen delivers one final message as Sinestro.
